task_completion.description: The abdominal CT volume is loaded into the medical imaging software (e.g., 3D Slicer).
task_completion.visual_evidence: A CT scan of an abdomen is visible in the slice viewers (Red/Green/Yellow views).

task_completion.description: Three distinct segments named 'Bone', 'Soft Tissue', and 'Air' are created in the segmentation list.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A list or table showing three segment entries with the specific names 'Bone', 'Soft Tissue', and 'Air'.

task_completion.description: The 'Bone' segment is defined using a threshold minimum of 300 HU.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The threshold tool interface showing a minimum value of 300 (or 300 to maximum) and the resulting mask highlighting skeletal structures.

task_completion.description: The 'Soft Tissue' segment is defined using a threshold range of 0 to 100 HU.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The threshold tool interface showing a range of 0 to 100 and the resulting mask highlighting organs/muscles.

task_completion.description: The 'Air' segment is defined using a threshold maximum of -500 HU.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The threshold tool interface showing a maximum value of -500 (or minimum to -500) and the resulting mask highlighting the background/bowel gas.

task_completion.description: The segmentation is exported/saved to the specific file path ~/Documents/SlicerData/Exports/tissue_segmentation.seg.nrrd.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Save' or 'Export' dialog box showing the file name 'tissue_segmentation.seg.nrrd' and the correct directory path.

integrity.description: The agent used the software GUI to perform segmentation rather than just running a script.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Segment Editor, threshold sliders, and segment lists.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply rename existing segments or load a pre-made file.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots showing the manual adjustment of threshold sliders and the progressive filling of the segments.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with a medical imaging suite (like 3D Slicer) and not a generic image editor.
integrity.visual_evidence: The application window title and layout correspond to 3D Slicer or similar medical DICOM viewers.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The required Hounsfield Unit (HU) thresholds are: Bone (Minimum 300), Soft Tissue (Range 0 to 100), and Air (Maximum -500). The final output must be a .seg.nrrd file saved in the ~/Documents/SlicerData/Exports/ directory.
